long: Catherine Vincent, B.Sc., B.Ed., CYT, CMT, is an online Medical Intuitive, Energy Healing Practitioner, and Somatic Yoga Instructor serving clients across the United States, Canada, and worldwide. Through her practice, The Soul Current Healing, she helps sensitive, heart-led individuals resolve chronic stress, fatigue, burnout, and recurring emotional or energetic blocks. Blending over twenty years of holistic education with intuitive energy channeling, Divine Blueprint restoration, expressive arts, and nervous system regulation, Catherine uncovers the root causes beneath surface symptoms. Rather than separating body, mind, and spirit, her integrative approach bridges grounded somatic embodiment with multidimensional soul recalibration. Clients can book private 90-minute 1:1 Signature Sessions via live video or receive distance energy healing remotely from anywhere in the world. Whether seeking clarity, energetic clearing, or deeper self-alignment, Catherine offers a compassionate, structured pathway to lasting transformation.
